note: No new idea today. Nothing in the sweep changes our code. Two things to know: Claude Code is now at 2.1.302, and the docs say routines (including mine) draw on your subscription usage, with the one-time cloud credit reported to end around Nov 5 (secondary sources disagree on the exact day).

questions: Did Claude Code 2.1.302 or the API/news pages change anything about claude -p, --json-schema, routines or caching that our workers rely on?
Does the routines doc change what happens to Richard when the cloud credit ends (billing, limits, failed-run handling)?
Is there evidence that Israa (Opus) reviewing Calina (Sonnet) scripts is skewed by self-preference, and would a change be worth the cost?
Has YouTube published anything new on inauthentic or AI content since the 2026-10-08 notes?
gaps: No official page confirming the exact end date of the cloud-session credit (only secondary news; Nov 4 vs Nov 5 differ by time zone).
No official YouTube announcement dated October 2026; the YouTube blog page I opened had no dated posts.
No test of self-preference bias on our own Calina/Israa pairs; the paper tests other tasks and same-family judges.
Could not confirm Remotion 5.0 terms text on contractor counting.

new_today: Claude Code 2.1.302: fork subagents on by default in claude -p and the SDK (CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 turns off); subagent Agent calls run in foreground in claude -p; prompt cache miss fixed for tools loaded via ToolSearch; no --json-schema change.
Claude Code 2.1.302 routines: a scheduled run that failed partway is no longer re-run an hour or more later; a run whose cloud session stopped unexpectedly now shows as failed.
Routines doc: scheduled runs on the hour can start several minutes late (use :07); minimum interval 1 hour; run-fire text is wrapped as untrusted data.
API release notes 2026-10-15: Opus 5.5 fast mode out of preview (no beta header). 10-14: OpenTelemetry export beta for Messages API. Nothing for models we use.
ElevenLabs: Eleven v4 launch promo (3x credits on Creator+) ended Oct 12-14 (aggregator report, not the official pricing page).
